description: A directional coupler consists of two single-mode waveguides that run in parallel for a coupling length, allowing evanescent coupling between them. The guides are connected at both ends via S-bend transitions to offset them vertically. The S-bends are smooth curves (radius-limited bends) that transition from the input/output section to the coupling region.
function_defining_knobs: wg_width: core waveguide width in micrometers
coupling_gap: center-to-center spacing between guides during coupling section
coupling_length: length of parallel coupling region
sbend_height: vertical offset the S-bend must achieve (guides move from coupling_gap spacing to parallel)
